_what: Her Claude chats a message to her phone may link to, and what each is for (card A-128). A notification links only an everyday chat that is open; the general one is where anything with no chat of its own goes. Checked against her live chats before a linked message is sent, and kept current: a closed chat is marked closed, never removed. Each everyday chat names the areas it covers ("modules"); "offers" keeps her answer when a chat for an area was offered, so it is never offered twice (card A-158).
